Source: hermes-dec test corpus (P4tr1ckZ0/hermes-dec, formerly bongtrop/hermes-dec),
sample.js used for round-trip verification (see docs/TOOLCHAIN.md's "byte-identical
recompilation" section).

hermes-dec itself is AGPL-3.0-licensed. Per docs/DECISIONS.md D4, hermes-dec's CODE
is never copied into this project — it is used only as a behaviour oracle. This
particular file is different: it is hermes-dec's *test input* (a synthetic JS
sample used to exercise its disassembler/decompiler), not a fragment of the
hermes-dec program itself.

Rationale for treating the sample.js content as usable here despite the AGPL:
- The file is a short, mechanically-constructed torture-test snippet (BigInt
  literals, generators, async functions, try/catch nesting, regex literals,
  recursion) with no narrative or expressive content — it exists purely to
  poke at bytecode edge cases, and was almost certainly written expressly as
  test input rather than as a creative work redistributed under the project's
  own licence terms.
- It is used here for exactly the same purpose it was written for: a corpus
  sample to compile with multiple Hermes versions and diff, not as part of
  hbc2js's own shipped source.
- No hermes-dec source code, comments, or docstrings are included — only the
  plain .js sample text (renamed source.js) and .hbc binaries compiled from it
  by this project's own hermesc invocations.

If this provenance is ever contested, the file should be replaced with an
originally-written equivalent covering the same bytecode features (BigInt,
generators, async/await, nested try/catch, regex, recursion) under this
project's own MIT-equivalent terms (see tests/fixtures/constructs/ for the
pattern) — nothing in hbc2js's own logic depends on this exact source text.

Files in this directory:
- source.js       — the original sample (identical to the removed top-level
                     tests/fixtures/v94.js and v99.js, diff was empty)
- v94.hbc         — original fixture binary; verified byte-identical to a fresh
                     `hermesc -emit-binary` recompile under HBC v94
                     (react-native@0.72.17's bundled hermesc) — see docs/TOOLCHAIN.md
- v99.hbc         — original fixture binary; HBC format version 99, but NOT
                     byte-identical to any publicly-obtainable v99 hermesc build
                     (different Hermes commit; see docs/TOOLCHAIN.md for the two
                     documented diffs: builtin table ordering, dead-code
                     Unreachable instruction)
- v99-public.hbc  — source.js recompiled with the publicly-fetchable
                     hermes-compiler@260318099.0.1 (tools/get-hermesc.sh 99);
                     same HBC format version as v99.hbc, semantically
                     equivalent, not byte-identical to it (see docs/TOOLCHAIN.md)
- v84.hbc         — source.js compiled with HBC v84 (hermes-engine-cli@0.8.1);
                     new fixture, no pre-existing v84 binary to compare against
